locales.title: One source of truth for agent rules
locales.summary: Stop maintaining diverging AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and .cursorrules files — build a checker that proves your repository has exactly one rule source, taught hands-on with your coding agent.

locales.summary: 不再同时维护彼此打架的 AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md 与 .cursorrules——亲手构建一个能证明仓库只有一处规则真源的检查器，由你的编码 Agent 授课。

locales.title: Measure the drift you already have
locales.summary: Run the checker against the three scenario repositories and read drift as a test failure, not a vibe.

locales.title: 量化你已经存在的漂移

locales.title: Decide the source of truth
locales.summary: AGENTS.md becomes the one file agents read; everything else is a pointer or a copy — decide, then write it down.

locales.title: 确定唯一真源

locales.title: Drive a bounded change, test by test

locales.title: 按测试驱动一次有边界的变更
locales.summary: 让 starter 依次识别真源、指针、副本与漂移——一次一组失败测试。

locales.title: Verify and wire it in

locales.title: 验证并接入流程
locales.summary: 证明验证器双向通过、跑完三个皮肤，然后把检查器接入你仓库的审查环。

locales.title: Apply this to your repository

locales.title: 把这套方法带回你的仓库

locales.title: Hands-on Python with Claude Code
locales.summary: An agent-taught course that takes you from a cloned folder to a tested, verified Python report tool using Claude Code — including the task contract, the bounded change, and the objective pass/fail evidence.

locales.title: 用 Claude Code 实战 Python
locales.summary: 一门由 Agent 授课的课程：从下载课程文件夹到交付一个经过测试与验证的 Python 报表工具——包括任务契约、最小变更和客观的通过/失败证据。

locales.title: Lesson 1: Reproduce the failure before you fix anything
locales.summary: Clone the folder, meet the starter, and make the failure objective with verify.py — the habit that separates "it runs" from "it ships".

locales.title: 第 1 课：先复现故障，再谈修复
locales.summary: 打开课程文件夹，认识 starter，用 verify.py 把"坏了"变成客观证据——这是"能跑"与"能交付"的分水岭。

locales.title: Lesson 2: Write the task contract before the change
locales.summary: Turn "make it better" into a bounded, testable contract — the single highest-leverage skill for working with coding agents.

locales.title: 第 2 课：动手之前先写任务契约
locales.summary: 把"优化一下"变成有边界、可测试的契约——这是与编码 Agent 协作杠杆最大的一项技能。

locales.title: Lesson 3: Drive a bounded change, test by test
locales.summary: Let the agent edit the starter under contract — smallest change, no new dependencies, red to green one group at a time.

locales.title: 第 3 课：按测试驱动一次有边界的变更
locales.summary: 让 Agent 在契约约束下修改 starter——最小变更、不新增依赖、一次一组测试从红到绿。

locales.title: Lesson 4: Verify like an engineer, review like a skeptic
locales.summary: Run the full verification loop, review the agent's diff for scope and side effects, and record what you did — and did not — prove.

locales.title: 第 4 课：像工程师一样验证，像怀疑者一样审查
locales.summary: 跑完整验证闭环，审查 Agent 的 diff 是否越界、有无副作用，并如实记录证明了什么、没证明什么。

locales.title: Lesson 5: Apply this to your own project
locales.summary: Port the workflow — not the code — to one script you own: contract, isolation, rounding, atomic writes, and an honest verification record.

locales.title: 第 5 课：把这套方法带回你自己的项目
locales.summary: 迁移工作流——而不是代码——到你拥有的一个脚本上：契约、错误隔离、舍入、原子写入，以及一份诚实的验证记录。

locales.title: Hands-on with OpenAI Codex CLI
locales.summary: The same verified Python workflow as the Claude Code course — task contract, bounded change, objective verify.py evidence — taught hands-on with the OpenAI Codex CLI instead.

locales.title: OpenAI Codex CLI 实战
locales.summary: 与 Claude Code 课程相同的已验证 Python 工作流——任务契约、最小变更、客观 verify.py 证据——改用 OpenAI Codex CLI 完成实战。

locales.title: Lesson 1: Reproduce the failure with Codex in the loop
locales.summary: Run the verifier both ways, map each failing test to a real-world failure class, and learn how to hand the folder to Codex.

locales.title: 第 1 课：让 Codex 进环，先复现故障
locales.summary: 双向运行验证器，把每个失败测试对应到真实故障，并学会如何把文件夹交给 Codex。

locales.title: Lesson 2: Write the task contract before the change
locales.summary: Turn "make it better" into bounded, testable statements — the single highest-leverage skill for driving Codex.

locales.title: 第 2 课：动手之前先写任务契约
locales.summary: 把“优化一下”变成有边界、可测试的陈述——驱动 Codex 杠杆最大的一项技能。

locales.title: Lesson 3: Drive a bounded change, test by test
locales.summary: Supervise Codex through seven small diffs — smallest change, no new dependencies, one failing test group at a time.

locales.title: 第 3 课：按测试驱动一次有边界的变更
locales.summary: 监督 Codex 完成七个小 diff——最小变更、不新增依赖、一次一组失败测试。

locales.title: Lesson 4: Verify like an engineer, review like a skeptic
locales.summary: Complete the evidence loop — both verification directions, all three skins, a scope-creep diff review, and a written record of what is not proven.

locales.title: 第 4 课：像工程师一样验证，像怀疑者一样审查
locales.summary: 完成证据闭环——双向验证、三个皮肤、范围蔓延 diff 审查，以及一份写明未证明内容的记录。

locales.title: Lesson 5: Apply this to your own project
locales.summary: Port the workflow — not the code — to one script you own, with tests, a verify command, and honest limits.

locales.title: 第 5 课：把这套方法带回你自己的项目
locales.summary: 迁移工作流——而不是代码——到你拥有的一个脚本上，附测试、验证命令与诚实的局限说明。

locales.title: Give your agent tools with MCP (Python)
locales.summary: Build a stateless Model Context Protocol tool server in pure Python — JSON-RPC 2.0 dispatch, schema validation, error isolation, and the 2026-07-28 input_required round-trip — and learn where a real tool belongs.

locales.title: 用 MCP 给你的 Agent 装上工具（Python）
locales.summary: 用纯 Python 构建一个无状态的 Model Context Protocol 工具服务——JSON-RPC 2.0 分发、schema 校验、错误隔离与 2026-07-28 的 input_required 多轮交互——并理解真正的工具该放在哪里。

locales.title: What MCP actually is (2026-07-28)
locales.summary: A stateless JSON-RPC 2.0 surface for tools — no handshake, no sessions, versions in _meta.

locales.title: MCP 到底是什么（2026-07-28）
locales.summary: 一个面向工具的无状态 JSON-RPC 2.0 接口——无握手、无会话、版本放在 _meta 里。

locales.title: The JSON-RPC dispatch contract
locales.summary: Valid requests echo their id; invalid ones get -32600; unknown or removed methods get -32601.

locales.title: JSON-RPC 分发契约
locales.summary: 合法请求回显 id；非法请求得 -32600；未知或已移除的方法得 -32601。

locales.title: Validation and error isolation
locales.summary: Arguments are untrusted input: validate before execution, and never let a handler crash the transport.

locales.title: 校验与错误隔离
locales.summary: 参数是不可信输入：先校验再执行，绝不让处理函数打断传输。

locales.title: The input_required round-trip
locales.summary: A tool can ask the client a question mid-call — return the requests, finish on the retry carrying answers.

locales.title: input_required 多轮交互
locales.summary: 工具可以在调用中途向客户端提问——先返回问题，客户端带答案重试后完成。

locales.title: Expose one real tool to your agent
locales.summary: Wrap one function you actually own behind the validated, isolated boundary you just built.

locales.title: 给你的 Agent 暴露一个真实工具
locales.summary: 把你真正拥有的一个函数包进刚建好的“校验 + 隔离”边界。

locales.title: From "it runs" to "it ships": verifying AI-generated code

locales.title: 从「能跑」到「能上线」：验证 AI 写的代码
locales.summary: 为你的 AI 项目补上缺失的发布证据机器——一个 ship check：运行测试、解析实际跑了什么、拒绝零测试项目，并写出诚实的交付记录。

locales.title: "It runs" is not evidence
locales.summary: Watch the starter bless a project with no tests and a project with a failing one — then want better.

locales.title: “能跑”不是证据
locales.summary: 看着 starter 给零测试的项目和有失败的项目都盖章放行——然后想要更好的东西。

locales.title: Define what a release record must prove
locales.summary: Command, exit code, parsed count and outcome, an unverified list, and a verdict that refuses zero-test projects.

locales.title: 定义发布记录必须证明什么
locales.summary: 命令、退出码、解析出的数量与结果、一份未验证清单，以及一个拒绝零测试项目的判定。

locales.title: Build the ship check, test by test
locales.summary: Parsing, verdicts, the unverified list, atomic writes, exit codes — one failing group at a time.

locales.title: 按测试逐组构建 ship check
locales.summary: 解析、判定、未验证清单、原子写入、退出码——一次一组失败测试。

locales.title: Read the record like a skeptic
locales.summary: Green, red, and no-tests mean different things — prove you can tell them apart and say what the record does not prove.

locales.title: 像怀疑者一样读记录
locales.summary: 绿、红、零测试是三件不同的事——证明你能分辨，并说清记录不能证明什么。

locales.title: Gate your next release
locales.summary: Take the ship check to a project you own and make the record part of shipping.

locales.title: 给你的下一次发布装上门禁
locales.summary: 把 ship check 带到你自己的项目，让记录成为交付的一部分。
